## Context
The user wants a line stating the date appended to `C:\uncli-spike\work\notes.txt`. This is a trivial, single-file change, so no further exploration or design agents are needed.

## First file to read
`C:\uncli-spike\work\notes.txt` — read before any edit.

2. Append a line such as `Date: 2026-10-23` (ISO format, today's date) using Edit (add after the last line) or Write if the file is new. Preserve existing content and line-ending style (likely CRLF on Windows).
